html:
What is beautiful about Sapa tourism in October is a question for those who travel to Sapa for the first time, still wondering where to visit in October, so to see the scenery of Sapa in October, let’s join Vietlook to Sapa today.

Sapa in October, the weather is in the fall, the cool breeze, along with the golden terraced fields, all the roads or villages are covered in brilliant yellow, especially villages such as: Lao Chai – Ta Van – Y Linh Ho are places that many tourists come to visit, especially young people who come here not only to visit but also to check in for themselves pictures next to the ripe rice season.

Sapa climate in October

October is the season of red leaves for many places, but Sapa is covered in a long yellow color, the temperature in Sapa at this time fluctuates from 18 to 25 degrees Celsius, the weather is clear during the day and cold at night.

In October, Sapa occasionally has showers, the morning is a bit cold and foggy, but when the sun just rises, the sky will be clear and visitors can record those moments as souvenirs, especially when on the top of Fansipan, visitors will record this beautiful scene, this is the most beautiful moment when going on a tour of Sapa in October.

What to wear when traveling to Sapa in October?

When coming to Sapa in October, you should bring autumn and winter clothes to wear in the early morning and late afternoon, because the temperature is cool during the day but cold in the early morning and late afternoon, but don’t forget to bring beautiful clothes to take pictures.

If you are a virtual person when visiting scenic spots, you can rent traditional costumes of the highlanders to capture beautiful photos, next to the autumn scenery of Sapa.

What is beautiful in October when traveling to Sapa?, and check-in points in Sapa

Fansipan Peak

When coming to Sapa, the first destination that visitors cannot miss is Fansipan Peak, located at an altitude of 3,143m. From here, visitors will immerse themselves in the sea of ​​clouds, from here they can see the whole view of Sapa from above.

Cat Cat Village

As one of the villages with many H’mong ethnic people living, when coming here, visitors can not only visit and enjoy the scenery, but also experience the life of the highlanders, especially the experience of weaving with brocades that visitors can buy as gifts.

Ham Rong Mountain

A check-in spot chosen by many tourists, especially young people who come here not only to visit but also to record beautiful pictures, it seems that this place has flowers blooming all year round, the weather is cool and the scenery is beautiful. Therefore, Ham Rong Mountain is a virtual living spot that cannot be missed when coming to Sapa.

Moana miniature landscape

A place with a beautiful view, there are many miniature landscapes for tourists to take virtual living, an indispensable destination when traveling to Sapa, no matter what angle visitors stand from, they can record beautiful pictures for themselves.

Ta Van Village, Lao Chai

Coming here in October, visitors will be immersed in the beauty of the golden season in the Northwest mountains, a beautiful scene for visitors to freely check in.

Sapa Dragon Cloud Glass Bridge

Located precariously on a rocky mountain, from the bridge visitors can admire the poetic beauty, below are villages milling terraced fields in golden autumn, visitors can capture beautiful moments in the Sapa weather in October.

Muong Hoa Valley

Coming here, visitors will be immersed in the colors of flowers, visitors experience the mountain train and admire the purple flowers, October Sapa has a little light sunshine with a faint scent, very suitable for visitors to visit and enjoy the scenery of Muong Hoa Valley in October.

Ban Y Linh Ho Sapa

A beautiful place to see the ripe rice season when traveling to Sapa in October, a place with rustic natural scenery, one of the peaceful villages, if you are a person who loves to admire the beautiful natural scenery, Ban Y Linh Ho Sapa is the destination for you.

Sapa O Long Tea Hill

October O Long Tea Hill has flower trees planted on the tea hill that have begun to bloom, especially coming here early in the morning, visitors will be satisfied with checking in next to the beautiful scenery, or when the dawn comes, the rays of sunlight shine in, creating a beautiful scene.

What to eat when traveling to Sapa in October?

The delicious dishes in Sapa include thang co, salmon and sturgeon hotpot, fish salad, grilled chicken, bamboo rice, grilled meat prepared with typical ingredients of the Northwest mountains, bringing a delicious flavor of its own. In addition, visitors can also order dishes on a tray of wild vegetables, stir-fried meat, grilled chicken, pork intestines, pork, cham cheo dipping sauce, fern salad… diners will remember this delicious flavor forever.

So above are the experiences of traveling to Sapa in October, Vietlook wants to share with you, to see that beauty with your own eyes, please register for the 3-day 2-night Sapa tour today.
